verses.original: וַֽיִּגְּשׁ֗וּ רָאשֵׁי֙ אֲב֣וֹת הַלְוִיִּ֔ם אֶל־ אֶלְעָזָר֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְאֶל־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ בִּן־ נ֑וּן וְאֶל־ רָאשֵׁ֛י אֲב֥וֹת הַמַּטּ֖וֹת לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yig·gə·šū rā·šê ’ă·ḇō·wṯ hal·wî·yim ’el- ’el·‘ā·zār hak·kō·hên wə·’el- yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ bin- nūn wə·’el- rā·šê ’ă·ḇō·wṯ ham·maṭ·ṭō·wṯ liḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Now the family heads of the Levites . . . approached Eleazar the priest . . . Joshua son of Nun and the heads of the other tribes of Israel
verses.literalPt: ENTÃO os cabeças dos pais dos levitas se achegaram a Eleazar, o sacerdote, e a Josué, filho de Num, e aos cabeças dos pais das tribos dos filhos de Israel;

verses.original: וַיְדַבְּר֨וּ אֲלֵיהֶ֜ם בְּשִׁלֹ֗ה בְּאֶ֤רֶץ כְּנַ֙עַן֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר יְהוָה֙ צִוָּ֣ה בְיַד־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה לָֽתֶת־ לָ֥נוּ עָרִ֖ים לָשָׁ֑בֶת וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶ֖ן לִבְהֶמְתֵּֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bə·rū ’ă·lê·hem bə·ši·lōh bə·’e·reṣ kə·na·‘an lê·mōr Yah·weh ṣiw·wāh ḇə·yaḏ- mō·šeh lā·ṯeṯ- lā·nū ‘ā·rîm lā·šā·ḇeṯ ū·miḡ·rə·šê·hen liḇ·hem·tê·nū
verses.literal: at Shiloh in the land of Canaan . . . and said to them The LORD commanded through Moses that we be given . . . cities in which to live together with pasturelands for our livestock
verses.literalPt: E falaram-lhes em Siló, na terra de Canaã, dizendo: O SENHOR ordenou, pelo ministério de Moisés, que se nos dessem cidades para habitar, e os seus arrabaldes para os nossos animais.

verses.original: וַיִּתְּנ֨וּ בְנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל לַלְוִיִּ֛ם מִנַּחֲלָתָ֖ם אֶל־ פִּ֣י יְהוָ֑ה אֶת־ הֶעָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה וְאֶת־ מִגְרְשֵׁיהֶֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tə·nū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl lal·wî·yim min·na·ḥă·lā·ṯām ’el- pî Yah·weh ’eṯ- he·‘ā·rîm hā·’êl·leh wə·’eṯ- miḡ·rə·šê·hen
verses.literal: So by the command of the LORD the Israelites . . . gave the Levites these cities and their pasturelands out of their own inheritance
verses.literalPt: Por isso os filhos de Israel deram aos levitas da sua herança, conforme a ordem do SENHOR, as seguintes cidades e os seus arrabaldes.

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֥א הַגּוֹרָ֖ל לְמִשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת הַקְּהָתִ֑י וַיְהִ֡י לִבְנֵי֩ אַהֲרֹ֨ן הַכֹּהֵ֜ן מִן־ הַלְוִיִּ֗ם מִמַּטֵּ֣ה יְ֠הוּדָה וּמִמַּטֵּ֨ה הַשִּׁמְעֹנִ֜י וּמִמַּטֵּ֤ה בִנְיָמִן֙ בַּגּוֹרָ֔ל עָרִ֖ים שְׁלֹ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣê hag·gō·w·rāl lə·miš·pə·ḥōṯ haq·qə·hā·ṯî way·hî liḇ·nê ’a·hă·rōn hak·kō·hên min- hal·wî·yim mim·maṭ·ṭêh yə·hū·ḏāh ū·mim·maṭ·ṭêh haš·šim·‘ō·nî ū·mim·maṭ·ṭêh ḇin·yā·min bag·gō·w·rāl ‘ā·rîm šə·lōš ‘eś·rêh
verses.literal: The first lot came out for the Kohathite clans The Levites who were descendants of Aaron the priest received thirteen . . . cities by lot from the tribes of Judah . . . Simeon . . . and Benjamin
verses.literalPt: E saiu a sorte para as famílias dos coatitas; e aos filhos de Arão, o sacerdote, que eram dos levitas, tiveram por sorte da tribo de Judá, e da tribo de Simeão, e da tribo de Benjamim, treze cidades;

verses.original: וְלִבְנֵ֨י קְהָ֜ת הַנּוֹתָרִ֗ים מִמִּשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת מַטֵּֽה־ אֶ֠פְרַיִם וּֽמִמַּטֵּה־ דָ֞ן וּמֵחֲצִ֨י מַטֵּ֧ה מְנַשֶּׁ֛ה בַּגּוֹרָ֖ל עָרִ֥ים עָֽשֶׂר׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·liḇ·nê qə·hāṯ han·nō·w·ṯā·rîm mim·miš·pə·ḥōṯ maṭ·ṭêh- ’ep̄·ra·yim ū·mim·maṭ·ṭêh- ḏān ū·mê·ḥă·ṣî maṭ·ṭêh mə·naš·šeh bag·gō·w·rāl ‘ā·rîm ‘ā·śer
verses.literal: The remaining descendants of Kohath received ten cities by lot from the tribes of Ephraim Dan and the half-tribe . . . of Manasseh
verses.literalPt: E aos outros filhos de Coate couberam por sorte, das famílias da tribo de Efraim, e da tribo de Dã, e da meia tribo de Manassés, dez cidades;

verses.original: וְלִבְנֵ֣י גֵרְשׁ֗וֹן מִמִּשְׁפְּח֣וֹת מַטֵּֽה־ יִשָּׂשכָ֣ר וּמִמַּטֵּֽה־ אָ֠שֵׁר וּמִמַּטֵּ֨ה נַפְתָּלִ֜י וּ֠מֵחֲצִי מַטֵּ֨ה מְנַשֶּׁ֤ה בַבָּשָׁן֙ בַּגּוֹרָ֔ל עָרִ֖ים שְׁלֹ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·liḇ·nê ḡê·rə·šō·wn mim·miš·pə·ḥō·wṯ maṭ·ṭêh- yiś·śā·š·ḵār ū·mim·maṭ·ṭêh- ’ā·šêr ū·mim·maṭ·ṭêh nap̄·tā·lî ū·mê·ḥă·ṣî maṭ·ṭêh mə·naš·šeh ḇab·bā·šān bag·gō·w·rāl ‘ā·rîm šə·lōš ‘eś·rêh
verses.literal: The descendants of Gershon received thirteen . . . cities by lot from the tribes of Issachar Asher . . . Naphtali and the half-tribe . . . of Manasseh in Bashan
verses.literalPt: E aos filhos de Gérson couberam por sorte, das famílias da tribo de Issacar, e da tribo de Aser, e da tribo de Naftali, e da meia tribo de Manassés, em Basã, treze cidades;

verses.original: לִבְנֵ֨י מְרָרִ֜י לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֗ם מִמַּטֵּ֨ה רְאוּבֵ֤ן וּמִמַּטֵּה־ גָד֙ וּמִמַּטֵּ֣ה זְבוּלֻ֔ן עָרִ֖ים שְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵֽה׃
verses.transliteration: liḇ·nê mə·rā·rî lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām mim·maṭ·ṭêh rə·’ū·ḇên ū·mim·maṭ·ṭêh- ḡāḏ ū·mim·maṭ·ṭêh zə·ḇū·lun ‘ā·rîm šə·têm ‘eś·rêh
verses.literal: And the descendants of Merari received twelve . . . cities from the tribes of Reuben . . . Gad . . . and Zebulun
verses.literalPt: Aos filhos de Merari, segundo as suas famílias, da tribo de Rúben, e da tribo de Gade, e da tribo de Zebulom, doze cidades;

verses.original: וַיִּתְּנ֤וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לַלְוִיִּ֔ם אֶת־ הֶעָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה וְאֶת־ מִגְרְשֵׁיהֶ֑ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה בְּיַד־ מֹשֶׁ֖ה בַּגּוֹרָֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tə·nū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl lal·wî·yim ’eṯ- he·‘ā·rîm hā·’êl·leh wə·’eṯ- miḡ·rə·šê·hen ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh bə·yaḏ- mō·šeh bag·gō·w·rāl
verses.literal: So the Israelites . . . allotted . . . to the Levites these cities together with their pasturelands as the LORD had commanded through Moses
verses.literalPt: E deram os filhos de Israel aos levitas estas cidades e os seus arrabaldes por sorte, como o SENHOR ordenara pelo ministério de Moisés.

verses.original: וַֽיִּתְּנ֗וּ מִמַּטֵּה֙ בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וּמִמַּטֵּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י שִׁמְע֑וֹן אֵ֚ת הֶֽעָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁר־ יִקְרָ֥א אֶתְהֶ֖ן בְּשֵֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tə·nū mim·maṭ·ṭêh bə·nê yə·hū·ḏāh ū·mim·maṭ·ṭêh bə·nê šim·‘ō·wn ’êṯ he·‘ā·rîm hā·’êl·leh ’ă·šer- yiq·rā ’eṯ·hen bə·šêm
verses.literal: From the tribes of Judah . . . . . . and Simeon they designated these - cities by name
verses.literalPt: Deram mais, da tribo dos filhos de Judá e da tribo dos filhos de Simeão, estas cidades, que por nome foram mencionadas,

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ לִבְנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֔ן מִמִּשְׁפְּח֥וֹת הַקְּהָתִ֖י מִבְּנֵ֣י לֵוִ֑י כִּ֥י לָהֶ֛ם הָיָ֥ה הַגּוֹרָ֖ל רִיאשֹׁנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî liḇ·nê ’a·hă·rōn mim·miš·pə·ḥō·wṯ haq·qə·hā·ṯî mib·bə·nê lê·wî kî lā·hem hā·yāh hag·gō·w·rāl rî·šō·nāh
verses.literal: to the descendants of Aaron from the Kohathite clans of the Levites . . . because the first lot fell to them
verses.literalPt: Para que fossem dos filhos de Arão, das famílias dos coatitas dos filhos de Levi; porquanto a primeira sorte foi sua.

verses.original: וַיִּתְּנ֨וּ לָהֶ֜ם אֶת־ קִרְיַת֩ אַרְבַּ֨ע אֲבִ֧י הָֽעֲנ֛וֹק הִ֥יא חֶבְר֖וֹן בְּהַ֣ר יְהוּדָ֑ה וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֖הָ סְבִיבֹתֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tə·nū lā·hem ’eṯ- qir·yaṯ ’ar·ba‘ ’ă·ḇî hā·‘ă·nō·wq hî ḥeḇ·rō·wn bə·har yə·hū·ḏāh wə·’eṯ- miḡ·rā·še·hā sə·ḇî·ḇō·ṯe·hā
verses.literal: They gave them Kiriath-arba (that is Hebron with its surrounding pasturelands in the hill country of Judah . . . Arba was the father of Anak
verses.literalPt: Assim lhes deram a cidade de Arba, do pai de Anaque (esta é Hebrom), no monte de Judá, e os seus arrabaldes ao redor.

verses.original: וְאֶת־ שְׂדֵ֥ה הָעִ֖יר וְאֶת־ חֲצֵרֶ֑יהָ נָֽתְנ֛וּ לְכָלֵ֥ב בֶּן־ יְפֻנֶּ֖ה בַּאֲחֻזָּתֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- śə·ḏêh hā·‘îr wə·’eṯ- ḥă·ṣê·re·hā nā·ṯə·nū lə·ḵā·lêḇ ben- yə·p̄un·neh ba·’ă·ḥuz·zā·ṯōw
verses.literal: But they had given the fields and villages around the city to Caleb son of Jephunneh as his possession
verses.literalPt: Porém o campo da cidade, e as suas aldeias, deram a Calebe, filho de Jefoné, por sua possessão.

verses.original: וְלִבְנֵ֣י׀ אַהֲרֹ֣ן הַכֹּהֵ֗ן נָֽתְנוּ֙ אֶת־ עִיר֙ מִקְלַ֣ט הָרֹצֵ֔חַ אֶת־ חֶבְר֖וֹן וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ וְאֶת־ לִבְנָ֖ה וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶֽׁהָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·liḇ·nê ’a·hă·rōn hak·kō·hên nā·ṯə·nū ’eṯ- ‘îr miq·laṭ hā·rō·ṣê·aḥ ’eṯ- ḥeḇ·rō·wn wə·’eṯ- miḡ·rā·še·hā wə·’eṯ- liḇ·nāh wə·’eṯ- miḡ·rā·še·hā
verses.literal: So to the descendants of Aaron the priest they gave these cities together with their pasturelands Hebron a city of refuge for the manslayer - Libnah
verses.literalPt: Assim aos filhos de Arão, o sacerdote, deram Hebrom, cidade do refúgio do homicida, e os seus arrabaldes, Libna e os seus arrabaldes;

verses.original: וְאֶת־ יַתִּר֙ וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ וְאֶת־ אֶשְׁתְּמֹ֖עַ וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶֽׁהָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- yat·tir wə·’eṯ- miḡ·rā·še·hā wə·’eṯ- ’eš·tə·mō·a‘ wə·’eṯ- miḡ·rā·še·hā
verses.literal: Jattir - Eshtemoa
verses.literalPt: Jatir e os seus arrabaldes, e Estemoa e os seus arrabaldes;

verses.original: וְאֶת־ חֹלֹן֙ וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ וְאֶת־ דְּבִ֖ר וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶֽׁהָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- ḥō·lōn wə·’eṯ- miḡ·rā·še·hā wə·’eṯ- də·ḇir wə·’eṯ- miḡ·rā·še·hā
verses.literal: Holon - Debir
verses.literalPt: E Holom e os seus arrabaldes, e Debir e os seus arrabaldes;

verses.original: וְאֶת־ עַ֣יִן וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֗הָ וְאֶת־ יֻטָּה֙ וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ אֶת־ בֵּ֥ית שֶׁ֖מֶשׁ וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ עָרִ֣ים תֵּ֔שַׁע מֵאֵ֕ת שְׁנֵ֥י הַשְּׁבָטִ֖ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- ‘a·yin wə·’eṯ- miḡ·rā·še·hā wə·’eṯ- yuṭ·ṭāh wə·’eṯ- miḡ·rā·še·hā ’eṯ- bêṯ še·meš wə·’eṯ- miḡ·rā·še·hā ‘ā·rîm tê·ša‘ mê·’êṯ šə·nê haš·šə·ḇā·ṭîm hā·’êl·leh
verses.literal: Ain - Juttah - and Beth-shemesh nine cities from these two tribes together with their pasturelands
verses.literalPt: E Aim e os seus arrabaldes, e Jutá e os seus arrabaldes, e Bete-Semes e os seus arrabaldes; nove cidades destas duas tribos.

verses.original: וּמִמַּטֵּ֣ה בִנְיָמִ֔ן אֶת־ גִּבְע֖וֹן וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ אֶת־ גֶּ֖בַע וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶֽׁהָ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mim·maṭ·ṭêh ḇin·yā·min ’eṯ- giḇ·‘ō·wn wə·’eṯ- miḡ·rā·še·hā ’eṯ- ge·ḇa‘ wə·’eṯ- miḡ·rā·še·hā
verses.literal: And from the tribe of Benjamin they gave them Gibeon - Geba
verses.literalPt: E da tribo de Benjamim, Gibeão e os seus arrabaldes, Geba e os seus arrabaldes;

verses.original: אֶת־ עֲנָתוֹת֙ וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ וְאֶת־ עַלְמ֖וֹן וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ עָרִ֖ים אַרְבַּֽע׃
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- ‘ă·nā·ṯō·wṯ wə·’eṯ- miḡ·rā·še·hā wə·’eṯ- ‘al·mō·wn wə·’eṯ- miḡ·rā·še·hā ‘ā·rîm ’ar·ba‘
verses.literal: Anathoth - and Almon four cities together with their pasturelands
verses.literalPt: Anatote e os seus arrabaldes, e Almom e os seus arrabaldes; quatro cidades.

verses.original: כָּל־ עָרֵ֥י בְנֵֽי־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן הַכֹּֽהֲנִ֑ים שְׁלֹשׁ־ עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה עָרִ֖ים וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: kāl- ‘ā·rê ḇə·nê- ’a·hă·rōn hak·kō·hă·nîm šə·lōš- ‘eś·rêh ‘ā·rîm ū·miḡ·rə·šê·hen
verses.literal: In all thirteen . . . cities together with their pasturelands were given to the priests the descendants of Aaron
verses.literalPt: Todas as cidades dos sacerdotes, filhos de Arão, foram treze cidades e os seus arrabaldes.

verses.original: וּלְמִשְׁפְּח֤וֹת בְּנֵֽי־ קְהָת֙ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם הַנּוֹתָרִ֖ים מִבְּנֵ֣י קְהָ֑ת וַֽיְהִי֙ עָרֵ֣י גֽוֹרָלָ֔ם מִמַּטֵּ֖ה אֶפְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·miš·pə·ḥō·wṯ bə·nê- qə·hāṯ hal·wî·yim han·nō·w·ṯā·rîm mib·bə·nê qə·hāṯ way·hî ‘ā·rê ḡō·w·rā·lām mim·maṭ·ṭêh ’ep̄·rā·yim
verses.literal: The remaining . . . Kohathite clans - of the Levites were allotted . . . these cities From the tribe of Ephraim
verses.literalPt: E as famílias dos filhos de Coate, levitas, que ficaram dos filhos de Coate, tiveram as cidades da sua sorte, da tribo de Efraim.

verses.original: וַיִּתְּנ֨וּ לָהֶ֜ם אֶת־ עִ֨יר מִקְלַ֧ט הָרֹצֵ֛חַ אֶת־ שְׁכֶ֥ם וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֖הָ בְּהַ֣ר אֶפְרָ֑יִם וְאֶת־ גֶּ֖זֶר וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶֽׁהָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tə·nū lā·hem ’eṯ- ‘îr miq·laṭ hā·rō·ṣê·aḥ ’eṯ- šə·ḵem wə·’eṯ- miḡ·rā·še·hā bə·har ’ep̄·rā·yim wə·’eṯ- ge·zer wə·’eṯ- miḡ·rā·še·hā
verses.literal: they were given Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim a city of refuge for the manslayer - Gezer
verses.literalPt: E deram-lhes Siquém, cidade de refúgio do homicida, e os seus arrabaldes, no monte de Efraim, e Gezer e os seus arrabaldes;

verses.original: וְאֶת־ קִבְצַ֙יִם֙ וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ וְאֶת־ בֵּ֥ית חוֹרֹ֖ן וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ עָרִ֖ים אַרְבַּֽע׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- qiḇ·ṣa·yim wə·’eṯ- miḡ·rā·še·hā wə·’eṯ- bêṯ ḥō·w·rōn wə·’eṯ- miḡ·rā·še·hā ‘ā·rîm ’ar·ba‘
verses.literal: Kibzaim - and Beth-horon four cities together with their pasturelands
verses.literalPt: E Quibzaim e os seus arrabaldes, e Bete-Horom e os seus arrabaldes; quatro cidades.

verses.original: וּמִמַּ֨טֵּה־ דָ֔ן אֶֽת־ אֶלְתְּקֵ֖א וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ אֶֽת־ גִּבְּת֖וֹן וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶֽׁהָ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mim·maṭ·ṭêh- ḏān ’eṯ- ’el·tə·qê wə·’eṯ- miḡ·rā·še·hā ’eṯ- gib·bə·ṯō·wn wə·’eṯ- miḡ·rā·še·hā
verses.literal: From the tribe of Dan they were given Elteke - Gibbethon
verses.literalPt: E da tribo de Dã, Elteque e os seus arrabaldes, Gibetom e os seus arrabaldes;

verses.original: אֶת־ אַיָּלוֹן֙ וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ אֶת־ גַּת־ רִמּ֖וֹן וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ עָרִ֖ים אַרְבַּֽע׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- ’ay·yā·lō·wn wə·’eṯ- miḡ·rā·še·hā ’eṯ- gaṯ- rim·mō·wn wə·’eṯ- miḡ·rā·še·hā ‘ā·rîm ’ar·ba‘
verses.literal: Aijalon - and Gath-rimmon four cities together with their pasturelands
verses.literalPt: Aijalom e os seus arrabaldes, Gate-Rimom e os seus arrabaldes; quatro cidades.

verses.original: וּמִֽמַּחֲצִית֙ מַטֵּ֣ה מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה אֶת־ תַּעְנַךְ֙ וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ וְאֶת־ גַּת־ רִמּ֖וֹן וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ עָרִ֖ים שְׁתָּֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mim·ma·ḥă·ṣîṯ maṭ·ṭêh mə·naš·šeh ’eṯ- ta‘·naḵ wə·’eṯ- miḡ·rā·še·hā wə·’eṯ- gaṯ- rim·mō·wn wə·’eṯ- miḡ·rā·še·hā ‘ā·rîm šə·tā·yim
verses.literal: And from the half-tribe . . . of Manasseh they were given Taanach - and Gath-rimmon two cities together with their pasturelands
verses.literalPt: E da meia tribo de Manassés, Taanaque e os seus arrabaldes, e Gate-Rimom e os seus arrabaldes; duas cidades.

verses.original: כָּל־ עָרִ֥ים עֶ֖שֶׂר וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶ֑ן לְמִשְׁפְּח֥וֹת בְּנֵֽי־ קְהָ֖ת הַנּוֹתָרִֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: kāl- ‘ā·rîm ‘e·śer ū·miḡ·rə·šê·hen lə·miš·pə·ḥō·wṯ bə·nê- qə·hāṯ han·nō·w·ṯā·rîm
verses.literal: In all ten cities together with their pasturelands were given to the rest of the Kohathite clans
verses.literalPt: As cidades para as famílias dos demais filhos de Coate, foram dez e os seus arrabaldes.

verses.original: וְלִבְנֵ֣י גֵרְשׁוֹן֮ מִמִּשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת הַלְוִיִּם֒ מֵחֲצִ֞י מַטֵּ֣ה מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה אֶת־ עִיר֙ מִקְלַ֣ט הָרֹצֵ֔חַ אֶת־ גָּלוֹן בַּבָּשָׁן֙ וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ וְאֶֽת־ בְּעֶשְׁתְּרָ֖ה וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ עָרִ֖ים שְׁתָּֽיִם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·liḇ·nê ḡê·rə·šō·wn mim·miš·pə·ḥōṯ hal·wî·yim mê·ḥă·ṣî maṭ·ṭêh mə·naš·šeh ’eṯ- ‘îr miq·laṭ hā·rō·ṣê·aḥ ’eṯ- gå̄·lōn bab·bā·šān wə·’eṯ- miḡ·rā·še·hā wə·’eṯ- bə·‘eš·tə·rāh wə·’eṯ- miḡ·rā·še·hā ‘ā·rîm šə·tā·yim
verses.literal: This is what the Levite clans of the Gershonites were given From the half-tribe . . . of Manasseh they were given Golan in Bashan a city of refuge for the manslayer - - and Beeshterah two cities together with their pasturelands
verses.literalPt: E aos filhos de Gérson, das famílias dos levitas, deram da meia tribo de Manassés, Golã, cidade de refúgio do homicida, em Basã, e os seus arrabaldes, e Beesterá e os seus arrabaldes; duas cidades.

verses.original: וּמִמַּטֵּ֣ה יִשָּׂשכָ֔ר אֶת־ קִשְׁי֖וֹן וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ אֶת־ דָּֽבְרַ֖ת וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶֽׁהָ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mim·maṭ·ṭêh yiś·śā·š·ḵār ’eṯ- qiš·yō·wn wə·’eṯ- miḡ·rā·še·hā ’eṯ- dā·ḇə·raṯ wə·’eṯ- miḡ·rā·še·hā
verses.literal: From the tribe of Issachar they were given Kishion - Daberath
verses.literalPt: E da tribo de Issacar, Quisiom e os seus arrabaldes, Daberate e os seus arrabaldes,

verses.original: אֶת־ יַרְמוּת֙ וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ אֶת־ עֵ֥ין גַּנִּ֖ים וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ עָרִ֖ים אַרְבַּֽע׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- yar·mūṯ wə·’eṯ- miḡ·rā·še·hā ’eṯ- ‘ên gan·nîm wə·’eṯ- miḡ·rā·še·hā ‘ā·rîm ’ar·ba‘
verses.literal: Jarmuth - and En-gannim four cities together with their pasturelands
verses.literalPt: Jarmute e os seus arrabaldes, En-Ganim e os seus arrabaldes; quatro cidades.

verses.original: וּמִמַּטֵּ֣ה אָשֵׁ֔ר אֶת־ מִשְׁאָ֖ל וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ אֶת־ עַבְדּ֖וֹן וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶֽׁהָ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mim·maṭ·ṭêh ’ā·šêr ’eṯ- miš·’āl wə·’eṯ- miḡ·rā·še·hā ’eṯ- ‘aḇ·dō·wn wə·’eṯ- miḡ·rā·še·hā
verses.literal: From the tribe of Asher they were given Mishal - Abdon
verses.literalPt: E da tribo de Aser, Misal e os seus arrabaldes, Abdom e os seus arrabaldes,

verses.original: אֶת־ חֶלְקָת֙ וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ וְאֶת־ רְחֹ֖ב וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ עָרִ֖ים אַרְבַּֽע׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- ḥel·qāṯ wə·’eṯ- miḡ·rā·še·hā wə·’eṯ- rə·ḥōḇ wə·’eṯ- miḡ·rā·še·hā ‘ā·rîm ’ar·ba‘
verses.literal: Helkath - and Rehob four cities together with their pasturelands
verses.literalPt: Helcate e os seus arrabaldes, e Reobe e os seus arrabaldes;

verses.original: וּמִמַּטֵּ֨ה נַפְתָּלִ֜י אֶת־ עִ֣יר׀ מִקְלַ֣ט הָֽרֹצֵ֗חַ אֶת־ קֶ֨דֶשׁ בַּגָּלִ֤יל וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֙הָ֙ וְאֶת־ חַמֹּ֥ת דֹּאר֙ וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ וְאֶת־ קַרְתָּ֖ן וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ עָרִ֖ים שָׁלֹֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mim·maṭ·ṭêh nap̄·tā·lî ’eṯ- ‘îr miq·laṭ hā·rō·ṣê·aḥ ’eṯ- qe·ḏeš bag·gā·lîl wə·’eṯ- miḡ·rā·še·hā wə·’eṯ- ḥam·mōṯ dōr wə·’eṯ- miḡ·rā·še·hā wə·’eṯ- qar·tān wə·’eṯ- miḡ·rā·še·hā ‘ā·rîm šā·lōš
verses.literal: And from the tribe of Naphtali they were given Kedesh in Galilee a city of refuge for the manslayer - Hammoth-dor - and Kartan three cities together with their pasturelands
verses.literalPt: E da tribo de Naftali, Quedes, cidade de refúgio do homicida, na Galiléia, e os seus arrabaldes, e Hamote-Dor e os seus arrabaldes, e Cartã e os seus arrabaldes; três cidades.

verses.original: כָּל־ עָרֵ֥י הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֖י לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם שְׁלֹשׁ־ עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה עִ֖יר וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: kāl- ‘ā·rê hag·gê·rə·šun·nî lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām šə·lōš- ‘eś·rêh ‘îr ū·miḡ·rə·šê·hen
verses.literal: In all thirteen . . . cities together with their pasturelands were given to the Gershonite clans
verses.literalPt: Todas as cidades dos gersonitas, segundo as suas famílias, foram treze cidades e os seus arrabaldes.

verses.original: וּלְמִשְׁפְּח֣וֹת בְּנֵֽי־ מְרָרִי֮ הַלְוִיִּ֣ם הַנּוֹתָרִים֒ מֵאֵת֙ מַטֵּ֣ה זְבוּלֻ֔ן אֶֽת־ יָקְנְעָ֖ם וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ אֶת־ קַרְתָּ֖ה וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶֽׁהָ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·miš·pə·ḥō·wṯ bə·nê- mə·rā·rî hal·wî·yim han·nō·w·ṯā·rîm mê·’êṯ maṭ·ṭêh zə·ḇū·lun ’eṯ- yā·qə·nə·‘ām wə·’eṯ- miḡ·rā·še·hā ’eṯ- qar·tāh wə·’eṯ- miḡ·rā·še·hā
verses.literal: This is what the Merarite clan the rest of . . . the Levites) were given From the tribe of Zebulun they were given Jokneam - Kartah
verses.literalPt: E às famílias dos filhos de Merari, aos demais levitas, foram dadas, da tribo de Zebulom, Jocneão e os seus arrabaldes, Cartã e os seus arrabaldes,

verses.original: אֶת־ דִּמְנָה֙ וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ אֶֽת־ נַהֲלָ֖ל וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ עָרִ֖ים אַרְבַּֽע׃
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- dim·nāh wə·’eṯ- miḡ·rā·še·hā ’eṯ- na·hă·lāl wə·’eṯ- miḡ·rā·še·hā ‘ā·rîm ’ar·ba‘
verses.literal: Dimnah - and Nahalal four cities together with their pasturelands
verses.literalPt: Dimna e os seus arrabaldes, Naalal e os seus arrabaldes; quatro cidades.

verses.original: וּמִמַּטֵּ֣ה רְאוּבֵ֔ן אֶת־ בֶּ֖צֶר וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ וְאֶת־ יַ֖הְצָה וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶֽׁהָ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mim·maṭ·ṭêh rə·’ū·ḇên ’eṯ- be·ṣer wə·’eṯ- miḡ·rā·še·hā wə·’eṯ- yah·ṣāh wə·’eṯ- miḡ·rā·še·hā
verses.literal: From the tribe of Reuben they were given Bezer - Jahaz
verses.literalPt: E da tribo de Rúben, Bezer e os seus arrabaldes, e Jaza e os seus arrabaldes,

verses.original: אֶת־ קְדֵמוֹת֙ וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ וְאֶת־ מֵיפָ֖עַת וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ עָרִ֖ים אַרְבַּֽע׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- qə·ḏê·mō·wṯ wə·’eṯ- miḡ·rā·še·hā wə·’eṯ- mê·p̄ā·‘aṯ wə·’eṯ- miḡ·rā·še·hā ‘ā·rîm ’ar·ba‘
verses.literal: Kedemoth - and Mephaath four cities together with their pasturelands
verses.literalPt: Quedemote e os seus arrabaldes, e Mefaate e os seus arrabaldes; quatro cidades.

verses.original: וּמִמַּטֵּה־ גָ֗ד אֶת־ עִיר֙ מִקְלַ֣ט הָרֹצֵ֔חַ אֶת־ רָמֹ֥ת בַּגִּלְעָ֖ד וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ וְאֶֽת־ מַחֲנַ֖יִם וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶֽׁהָ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mim·maṭ·ṭêh- ḡāḏ ’eṯ- ‘îr miq·laṭ hā·rō·ṣê·aḥ ’eṯ- rā·mōṯ bag·gil·‘āḏ wə·’eṯ- miḡ·rā·še·hā wə·’eṯ- ma·ḥă·na·yim wə·’eṯ- miḡ·rā·še·hā
verses.literal: And from the tribe of Gad they were given Ramoth in Gilead a city of refuge for the manslayer - Mahanaim
verses.literalPt: E da tribo de Gade, Ramote, cidade de refúgio do homicida, em Gileade, e os seus arrabaldes, e Maanaim e os seus arrabaldes,

verses.original: אֶת־ חֶשְׁבּוֹן֙ וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ אֶת־ יַעְזֵ֖ר וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ כָּל־ עָרִ֖ים אַרְבַּֽע׃
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- ḥeš·bō·wn wə·’eṯ- miḡ·rā·še·hā ’eṯ- ya‘·zêr wə·’eṯ- miḡ·rā·še·hā kāl- ‘ā·rîm ’ar·ba‘
verses.literal: Heshbon - and Jazer four cities in all together with their pasturelands
verses.literalPt: Hesbom e os seus arrabaldes, Jazer e os seus arrabaldes; ao todo, quatro cidades.

verses.original: כָּל־ הֶ֨עָרִ֜ים לִבְנֵ֤י מְרָרִי֙ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֔ם הַנּוֹתָרִ֖ים מִמִּשְׁפְּח֣וֹת הַלְוִיִּ֑ם וַיְהִי֙ גּוֹרָלָ֔ם עָרִ֖ים שְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- he·‘ā·rîm liḇ·nê mə·rā·rî lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām han·nō·w·ṯā·rîm mim·miš·pə·ḥō·wṯ hal·wî·yim way·hî gō·w·rā·lām ‘ā·rîm šə·têm ‘eś·rêh
verses.literal: In all twelve . . . cities were allotted to the clans of Merari the remaining Levite clans
verses.literalPt: Todas estas cidades foram dos filhos de Merari, segundo as suas famílias, que ainda restavam das famílias, dos levitas; e foi a sua sorte doze cidades.

verses.original: כֹּ֚ל עָרֵ֣י הַלְוִיִּ֔ם בְּת֖וֹךְ אֲחֻזַּ֣ת בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עָרִ֛ים אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנֶ֖ה וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶֽן׃
verses.transliteration: kōl ‘ā·rê hal·wî·yim bə·ṯō·wḵ ’ă·ḥuz·zaṯ bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ‘ā·rîm ’ar·bā·‘îm ū·šə·mō·neh ū·miḡ·rə·šê·hen
verses.literal: For the Levites, then there were forty-eight . . . cities in all together with their pasturelands within the territory of the Israelites . . .
verses.literalPt: Todas as cidades dos levitas, no meio da herança dos filhos de Israel, foram quarenta e oito cidades e os seus arrabaldes.

verses.original: תִּֽהְיֶ֙ינָה֙ הֶעָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה עִ֣יר עִ֔יר וּמִגְרָשֶׁ֖יהָ סְבִיבֹתֶ֑יהָ כֵּ֖ן לְכָל־ הֶעָרִ֥ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃ס
verses.transliteration: tih·ye·nāh he·‘ā·rîm hā·’êl·leh ‘îr ‘îr ū·miḡ·rā·še·hā sə·ḇî·ḇō·ṯe·hā kên lə·ḵāl he·‘ā·rîm hā·’êl·leh
verses.literal: Each . . . of these cities had its own surrounding pasturelands this was true for all the cities
verses.literalPt: Estavam estas cidades, cada uma com os seus arrabaldes em redor delas; assim estavam todas estas cidades.

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֤ן יְהוָה֙ לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶת־ כָּל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּ֖ע לָתֵ֣ת לַאֲבוֹתָ֑ם וַיִּרָשׁ֖וּהָ וַיֵּ֥שְׁבוּ בָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tên Yah·weh lə·yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer niš·ba‘ lā·ṯêṯ la·’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām way·yi·rā·šū·hā way·yê·šə·ḇū ḇāh
verses.literal: Thus the LORD gave Israel all the land He had sworn to give their fathers and they took possession of it and settled in it
verses.literalPt: Desta maneira deu o SENHOR a Israel toda a terra que jurara dar a seus pais; e a possuíram e habitaram nela.

verses.original: וַיָּ֨נַח יְהוָ֤ה לָהֶם֙ מִסָּבִ֔יב כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ נִשְׁבַּ֖ע לַאֲבוֹתָ֑ם וְלֹא־ עָ֨מַד אִ֤ישׁ בִּפְנֵיהֶם֙ מִכָּל־ אֹ֣יְבֵיהֶ֔ם אֵ֚ת כָּל־ אֹ֣יְבֵיהֶ֔ם נָתַ֥ן יְהוָ֖ה בְּיָדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·naḥ Yah·weh lā·hem mis·sā·ḇîḇ kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- niš·ba‘ la·’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām wə·lō- ‘ā·maḏ ’îš bip̄·nê·hem mik·kāl ’ō·yə·ḇê·hem ’êṯ kāl- ’ō·yə·ḇê·hem nā·ṯan Yah·weh bə·yā·ḏām
verses.literal: And the LORD gave them rest . . . on every side just as He had sworn to their fathers None . . . of their enemies - could stand against them for the LORD delivered all their enemies into their hand
verses.literalPt: E o SENHOR lhes deu repouso de todos os lados, conforme a tudo quanto jurara a seus pais; e nenhum de todos os seus inimigos pôde resisti-los; todos os seus inimigos o SENHOR entregou-lhes nas mãos.

verses.original: לֹֽא־ נָפַ֣ל דָּבָ֔ר מִכֹּל֙ הַדָּבָ֣ר הַטּ֔וֹב אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הַכֹּ֖ל בָּֽא׃פ
verses.transliteration: lō- nā·p̄al dā·ḇār mik·kōl had·dā·ḇār haṭ·ṭō·wḇ ’ă·šer- dib·ber Yah·weh ’el- bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl hak·kōl bā
verses.literal: Not one of all . . . the LORD’s good promises to the house of Israel had failed everything was fulfilled
verses.literalPt: Palavra alguma falhou de todas as boas coisas que o SENHOR falou à casa de Israel; tudo se cumpriu.
